# Half marathon prep

## Context

Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses. Resting heart rate is down to 15 after three months. Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away.

## Notes

Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises. Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking.

## Status

Intervals on Monday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast.

## Next steps

New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat. Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.
